purpose: The discipline of holding a working gold or support bath inside its supplier-TDS operating window: reasoning about what gold content, pH, temperature, agitation and additive balance each do to the deposit, reading drift signatures and early-warning signals, choosing the right analysis method class (titration, Hull cell, coupon plus XRF, supplier lab) for each question, and deciding when and how to replenish little-and-often, when to invoke crash correction, and when a bath may or may not accept customer work.
assumptions: no observed dataset supplied; all scores are heuristic priors
every bath in scope is a purchased commercial plating product operated per the technical data sheet (TDS) of that specific product; the TDS governs every setpoint and window

the reference chemistries for mechanism reasoning are the alkaline cyanide gold family and the acid hard gold family as documented in the in-repo process corpus; their published handbook-class ranges are cited as ranges, never restated as universal setpoints
the operating context is a small jewelry plating bench with a bath log, bench wet-analysis capability, Hull cell and coupon practice, and access to the chemistry supplier's analytical service
safety obligations (segregation, PPE, ventilation, training, emergency readiness) are obligation classes pointing to formal training and the shop's jurisdiction rules, never improvised procedure
exclusions: choosing which gold system to buy: alkaline cyanide versus neutral or acid hard gold versus sulfite and non-cyanide alternatives versus electroless and immersion classes, strike versus color versus build bath architecture, color and karat hue design as an alloying mechanism, support bath (nickel, palladium, copper) selection, and PVD as an alternative class - all of that is the sibling bath-families-and-selection KB

why baths die: drag-in and drag-out control, metallic and organic contamination signatures and their treatment, filtration and carbon treatment as method classes, bath aging economics, the regenerate-versus-retire decision, and gold recovery from spent solutions and rinses - all of that is the sibling contamination-and-lifecycle KB; this KB only recognizes when a problem has crossed into that territory

inventing numeric setpoints: no temperature, pH, concentration, current density or dosing figure in this KB is a universal truth; operating windows come from the TDS of the specific commercial product, and published handbook-class ranges are referenced only as handbook-class ranges
DIY bath formulation or augmentation from raw chemicals; commercial plating products dosed per their TDS only

improvised cyanide or acid procedure: cyanide content is safety-class guidance pointing to formal training and jurisdiction workplace and hazmat rules; cyanide-bearing and acid process tanks are physically and procedurally segregated everywhere they are mentioned

per-job electrical delivery (surface-area estimation, current density selection, fixturing, thickness delivery) - that belongs to the process-execution specialist; this KB owns the bath side of the same story
personalized legal, medical or financial advice; regulated marking terms and discharge rules appear only as verify-your-jurisdiction obligation classes

competency_questions.question: Where do the numbers for my bath come from, and what may I never do with a number I remember from somewhere else?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: TDS_WINDOW_DOCTRINE names the product TDS as the sole authority for windows and dosing, demotes handbook ranges to orientation classes, and forbids invented setpoints and raw-chemical improvisation

competency_questions.question: What must I record and produce on the day a new bath is made up, and what goes wrong later if I skip it?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: BATH_COMMISSIONING_BASELINE lists the make-up record, initial analysis and reference artifacts (Hull panel, witness coupon, color plaque) and explains that all later drift judgment anchors to them

competency_questions.question: What goes into the bath log every session, and how does the log earn its keep when something goes wrong weeks later?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: BATH_LOG_DISCIPLINE defines the minimum record set (work, ampere-minutes, measurements, additions with lot and reason, observations) and AMPERE_MINUTE_BOOKKEEPING shows the log driving predicted replenishment and later traceback

competency_questions.question: What does each controlled parameter - gold content, pH, temperature, agitation, additive and hardener balance - actually do to the deposit, and what does its drift look like at the bench?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: each parameter node states the mechanism, the too-low and too-high consequences as deposit evidence, and defers the numeric window to the TDS

competency_questions.question: What is special about the alkaline cyanide family's two housekeeping parameters - free cyanide and carbonate - and why can a bath measure healthy on gold yet plate badly because of them?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: FREE_CYANIDE_BALANCE explains complex stability and immersion-deposit suppression with the low-cyanide adhesion signature, and CARBONATE_BYPRODUCT_LOAD explains inherent byproduct creep, its dull-for-no-reason signature and the freeze-out and partial-refresh countermeasure classes

competency_questions.question: My deposit changed - burnt edges, dull haze, off color, smutty film, slow build - how do I get from the symptom to a testable cause hypothesis instead of a guess?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: DRIFT_SIGNATURE_MAP maps each deposit symptom to its candidate parameter causes and ends every signature in the measurement that would confirm or kill the hypothesis

competency_questions.question: Which early-warning signals should routine work watch so drift is caught before the first rejected part?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: EARLY_WARNING_SENTINELS names the sentinel set (color check against the retained reference, voltage-at-fixed-current, first-article coupon, thickness-per-ampere-minute trend, periodic Hull panel) with alert bands derived from baseline and log scatter

competency_questions.question: Which analysis method class answers which question about my bath, and what is each class blind to?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: the four method nodes assign titration to concentrations, the Hull cell to current-density-swept deposit behavior, the coupon plus XRF to delivered thickness and efficiency, and the supplier lab to what the bench cannot measure, each with its stated limits

competency_questions.question: Two pieces of evidence about the same bath disagree - what do I trust, in what order, and what must I not do while they disagree?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: MEASUREMENT_DISAGREEMENT_ARBITRATION gives the ladder (calibration and sampling first, repeat, independent method, supplier lab) and the no-dosing-during-arbitration rule

competency_questions.question: How do I estimate the gold my bath consumed since the last addition, and why must that estimate never replace measurement?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: AMPERE_MINUTE_BOOKKEEPING presents charge-based consumption estimation as a mechanism reconciled against analysis, and GOLD_CONTENT_MECHANISM explains what depleted gold does to the deposit while the arithmetic still looks fine

competency_questions.question: Why is little-and-often replenishment the default, and exactly when does the crash-correction protocol take over from it?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: LITTLE_AND_OFTEN_DOSING states the measure-add-mix-verify loop and one-variable discipline, and CRASH_CORRECTION_PROTOCOL states the outside-the-window trigger, the stop on customer work, and the evidence needed to return to service

competency_questions.question: What safety lines govern sampling, titration, dosing and pH trimming around cyanide-bearing and acid baths, and which of them are absolute?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CYANIDE_ACID_SEGREGATION_GUARD states the never-mix, never-store-together, never-share-a-drain line with the HCN mechanism, the alkalinity and acid-side pH floors as safety lines, and the formal-training and jurisdiction-rule pointers; PH_WINDOW_MECHANISM restricts trimming to TDS-named chemicals

competency_questions.question: What gets checked on each tank at what cadence, who owns each check, and what makes the cadence tighten?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CONTROL_CADENCE_PLAN scales cadence by TDS guidance, workload and stakes, assigns an owner per check, and tightens automatically after excursions or failed release checks

competency_questions.question: What must be true of a bath before customer work enters it, and when is a bath problem beyond this KB's bench corrections?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: BATH_RELEASE_GATE lists the release conditions (in-window cadence measurements, no open corrections or alarms, first-article evidence for high-stakes work), and SUPPLIER_LAB_ESCALATION plus CRASH_CORRECTION_PROTOCOL name the handoff to the supplier lab and to the lifecycle KB's regenerate-or-retire decision

glossary.definition: The supplier's operating document for a specific commercial plating product: it names the controlled parameters, their windows, the sanctioned replenishment and trim chemicals and their dosing arithmetic; in this KB the TDS is the sole authority for every number, and the safety data sheet (SDS) that accompanies it carries the hazard classes.

The TDS-stated range for a controlled parameter (gold content, pH, temperature, current density, additive level) inside which the product is warranted to plate as specified; drift is movement toward an edge, an excursion is a measurement outside it.

The recognizable deposit-side evidence of a parameter moving in the bath: burnt brown edges, dull haze, hue shift against the retained plaque, smutty non-adherent film, or slowing build rate - each signature is a hypothesis about which parameter moved, to be confirmed by measurement before anything is dosed.

A small trapezoidal test cell that plates one panel across a continuous low-to-high current density sweep in a single run, making additive imbalance, contamination haze and burning-threshold shifts visible as patterns along the panel; read comparatively against the bath's baseline panel.

A standard substrate plated under known conditions (fixed area, current, time) whose measured thickness and appearance prove what the bath actually delivers; with XRF thickness measurement it yields the bath's current efficiency and arbitrates disputes between solution analysis and part quality.

X-ray fluorescence measurement of coating thickness and composition on a coupon or part - non-destructive, geometry- and calibration-limited, available as an owned instrument or a send-out service; the method class behind thickness-per-ampere-minute tracking.

Uncomplexed cyanide held in excess in the alkaline gold family per the product TDS: it stabilizes the gold complex, dissolves drag-in and suppresses immersion (displacement) deposition; it exists safely only in strongly alkaline solution and its titration is itself a cyanide-handling task for trained hands.

The byproduct that accumulates in alkaline cyanide baths from cyanide oxidation and carbon dioxide absorption; past the product's service guidance it dulls deposits from a bath whose other numbers still measure in-window, and it is managed by chill freeze-out or partial refresh per supplier guidance.

The consumption ledger built on Faraday's proportionality between charge and deposited metal: logged ampere-minutes times measured efficiency estimate the gold that left with the work and predict the next replenishment, always reconciled against analysis rather than trusted alone.

The default dosing discipline: small, frequent, measured additions of the TDS-named product that keep every parameter near the center of its window, one variable per correction cycle, each addition logged and verified - the opposite of letting a bath drift to an edge and rescuing it with one heroic correction.

nodes.definition: Anchor every control decision to the supplier's technical data sheet for the specific commercial product in the tank: the TDS names the controlled parameters (gold content, pH, temperature, current density range, agitation class, additive dosing), gives each its window, and names the only sanctioned replenishment and trim chemicals with their dosing arithmetic. The bench's job is to hold the bath inside those windows and to understand what each parameter does - never to invent setpoints, never to borrow numbers from a different product or a half-remembered handbook, and never to compound or augment a bath from raw chemicals. Published handbook-class ranges are orientation for understanding mechanisms; the TDS of the product actually in the tank always governs the numbers, and the shop's logged history refines where inside the window a bath runs best without ever overriding the window's edges.

included: the TDS as sole authority for windows, dosing chemicals and amounts
handbook-class ranges demoted to orientation
commercial-product-only rule
control card transcription of TDS windows per tank
excluded: choosing which gold system to buy (bath-families KB)
any invented universal setpoint
raw-chemical formulation or augmentation

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: the supplier revises the TDS or the tank is refilled with a different commercial product

pros.claim: A single named authority for every number ends the remembered-setpoint argument culture that wrecks baths
pros.example: when two operators recall different pH targets for the acid hard gold, the TDS revision taped to the tank's control card settles it in seconds

cons.claim: TDS windows are generic and conservative, so a bath can be fully in-window yet not at its best for one shop's work mix
cons.example: a flash color bath legal on every TDS line can still drift visibly against the shop's retained plaque; the log, not the TDS, finds where in the window that bath runs truest

failure_modes: running a new product on the numbers remembered from the previous product
treating a published handbook range as a setpoint for the specific bath in the tank
adding a raw chemical the TDS never names because a forum post said it helps
acceptance_tests: every controlled parameter on each tank's control card carries a window transcribed from the named product TDS with its revision date, and no number on the card lacks a TDS source
revisit_triggers: the supplier issues a TDS revision or discontinues the product
a tank is refilled with a different commercial product

nodes.definition: Hold the safety envelope inside which all sampling, titration, dosing and pH trimming happen: cyanide-bearing solutions (alkaline gold baths and strikes, their rinses and their samples) and acids are never mixed, never stored together, and never share a drain, because acid contact with cyanide liberates hydrogen cyanide gas. Alkaline cyanide baths additionally carry a hard alkalinity floor - handbook chemistry puts the onset of HCN evolution below roughly pH 10.5 for free-cyanide solutions - and acid gold baths carry their own acid-side floor near pH 3 where the aurocyanide complex begins releasing HCN. This node is boundary, not procedure: it points to formal cyanide-handling training, jurisdiction workplace and hazmat rules, ventilation, PPE, labeled zones, separate spill kits and emergency readiness as obligation classes, and it forbids improvising any of them at the bench.

included: absolute segregation of cyanide and acid chemistry, storage and drains
pH floors as life-safety lines for both families
formal-training and jurisdiction-rule pointers
zone rules for samples, probes and dosing gear
excluded: improvised or step-by-step emergency procedure (formal training territory)
waste characterization and disposal routing (safety-compliance specialist)
medical advice on exposure (professional care)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a near-miss report, a layout change, or new jurisdiction guidance on cyanide or acid handling

pros.claim: An absolute line is teachable, auditable and survives staff turnover in a way judgment calls do not
pros.example: sample beakers, stirrers and pH probes are color-coded per zone so a cyanide-bath probe physically cannot end up in the pickle line

cons.claim: Absolute segregation costs duplicate equipment and bench time and will be resented on busy days
cons.example: the shop needs a second pH meter or a documented decontamination step between zones; the guard accepts that cost without exception

failure_modes: trimming pH with a strong acid anywhere near cyanide-bearing chemistry because it is the fastest fix
one sampling kit wandering between the cyanide and acid zones
treating the alkalinity floor as a quality number to optimize instead of a life-safety line
acceptance_tests: cyanide and acid chemistry have physically separate, labeled zones, storage and drains, every person who samples or doses a cyanide-bearing bath holds current formal training named in the shop record, and the jurisdiction's workplace and hazmat rules are cited on the shop safety sheet
revisit_triggers: any near-miss or excursion touching the segregation line or a pH floor
a layout, equipment or staffing change that moves where chemistry is handled
new jurisdiction guidance on cyanide handling or storage

nodes.definition: Turn a fresh make-up into a bath the shop can control: at commissioning, record the product name and TDS revision, tank volume, make-up amounts and lot numbers, and the initial measured analysis (gold content, pH at operating temperature, and whichever of free cyanide or hardener metal the TDS controls), then produce the reference artifacts that all later drift will be judged against - a Hull cell panel from the healthy new bath, a plated witness coupon on the standard substrate at known ampere-minutes, and for color baths a plaque held against the retained color standard. This dated baseline is the bath's birth certificate: without it every later is-it-drifting argument has no anchor, sentinel alert bands have nothing to be derived from, and the supplier lab gets a mystery instead of a history.

included: make-up record with lots and volumes
initial measured analysis
baseline Hull panel, witness coupon and color plaque
dated, labeled retention of the reference artifacts
excluded: deciding which product to commission (bath-families KB)
ongoing routine logging (bath log node)
end-of-life judgment on an aged bath (lifecycle KB)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a re-baselining event: major correction, supplier purification, or product change

pros.claim: A healthy-day reference makes small drift visible while it is still cheap to correct
pros.example: the shift operator holds today's Hull panel next to the commissioning panel and sees the low-current end dulling before a single part is rejected

cons.claim: Baselining costs bench time exactly when everyone wants the new bath earning
cons.example: an hour of panels and coupons on make-up day, against days of argument when the first dull batch appears with nothing to compare it to

failure_modes: first customer job runs before any baseline exists
baseline artifacts left unlabeled or undated so later comparison proves nothing
recording what was poured in but never measuring what the bath actually reads
acceptance_tests: before the first customer job, the tank has a dated make-up record with product, TDS revision, lots and volumes, an initial measured analysis, and labeled baseline artifacts (Hull panel, witness coupon, and color plaque where color matters) in retention
revisit_triggers: a supplier lab report or major correction materially changes the bath's composition
the product or its TDS revision changes
baseline artifacts age or fade beyond honest comparison

nodes.definition: Run the bath log as the shop's evidence base: one dated entry stream per tank recording work processed (jobs and their ampere-minutes), every measurement with its method (pH at temperature, temperature, titration and analysis results), every addition (product, amount, lot number, reason), every excursion, and free-text observations like slightly paler at the rack ends. The log is what turns anecdote into control: drift becomes a trend instead of a surprise, a defect three weeks later traces to the correction that preceded it, replenishment prediction has data to run on, and the supplier lab's first request - what has this bath seen - has an answer. Entries are made at the moment of the event by the person who did it; a reconstructed log is fiction wearing a lab coat.

included: minimum record set per entry
at-the-moment recording rule
the log as troubleshooting memory and supplier-lab evidence
ampere-minute capture per job
excluded: job pricing and customer records (business specialist)
run-level fixturing records (process-execution specialist)
waste manifests (safety-compliance specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a traceback attempt that the log could or could not support

pros.claim: A live log converts one operator's afternoon observation into the whole shop's permanent knowledge
pros.example: the note slightly dull at low current after Tuesday's big batch is what lets Friday's troubleshooter date the start of the carbonate creep

cons.claim: Full logging costs minutes on every job and the cost lands on the busiest days
cons.example: a rush afternoon tempts the operator to batch-write entries at closing, by which time the addition amounts are guesses

failure_modes: entries reconstructed from memory at the end of the day
additions logged without amount, lot or reason
measurements logged without method or temperature so later comparison is apples to oranges
acceptance_tests: any sampled week of the log shows every addition with product, amount, lot and reason, every measurement with method and temperature, and ampere-minutes per job, each entry dated and initialed
revisit_triggers: a troubleshooting session fails because the log could not answer what the bath had seen
the log format changes or moves medium (paper to digital)

nodes.definition: Reason about dissolved gold as the bath's supply mechanism: gold reaching the cathode film is what plates, so as metal content falls toward the low edge of the TDS window the usable current density ceiling falls with it - the rack current that plated bright yesterday burns brown at the edges today, cathode efficiency sags, and plating slows. Grossly high content buys nothing the TDS did not promise while locking up capital and raising the value lost in drag-out. Gold leaves with every plated part, so content is a consumable: it is measured on cadence, predicted by the consumption bookkeeping, and restored with the TDS-named gold salt or replenisher concentrate - in the classic families a potassium gold cyanide product - never with anything else. Where the window sits and how tight it is belongs to the product TDS; this node owns what the parameter does and how its drift shows up at the bench.

included: gold content as the current-density ceiling setter
depletion and excess consequences as deposit evidence
replenishment with the TDS-named gold source only
excluded: numeric concentration setpoints (TDS territory)
drag-out reduction technique (lifecycle KB)
per-job current selection (process-execution specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: measured gold content versus bookkeeping prediction diverging, or a change in the sanctioned replenisher

pros.claim: Reading burnt edges as a supply question saves the reflex of blaming the rectifier
pros.example: before touching the current knob, the operator asks when gold was last measured - and finds the bath a third below its window after a heavy week

cons.claim: Gold content explains burning only jointly with temperature and agitation, so it can take the blame that belongs elsewhere
cons.example: a bath dosed up on gold still burns because the heater failed overnight and nobody checked the thermometer first

failure_modes: dosing gold on a burn symptom without measuring content first
running lean far below the window to save inventory and scrapping a batch to burn marks
treating gold content as constant because parts keep coming out
acceptance_tests: the operator can state for their bath what low gold looks like on parts, name the TDS window and the sanctioned replenisher, and show the last measured content in the log
revisit_triggers: measured consumption diverges from bookkeeping prediction
the TDS window or replenisher product changes

nodes.definition: Reason about pH per bath family class as both a quality lever and a safety line. In the alkaline cyanide family, strong alkalinity keeps the gold complex stable and the bath safe; the alkalinity floor is a life-safety line before it is a quality number, so alkaline pH trouble is treated as a safety event first. In the acid hard gold family the TDS window - handbook-class mid-3s to about 5 - sets efficiency, hardness and color together; pH creeps down in normal service because the insoluble-anode reaction generates acid, so downward drift is expected and trimmed routinely; and the acid-side floor near pH 3 is again a safety line where the complex begins releasing HCN. Measurement is a calibrated meter read at operating temperature; correction is stepwise with only the trim chemical the TDS names for that bath - the sanctioned alkali upward, the sanctioned mild acid downward in acid baths - and never any strong acid anywhere near cyanide-bearing chemistry.

included: pH mechanism per family class
expected downward creep in acid gold service
TDS-named trim chemicals only
pH floors as safety lines
excluded: numeric pH setpoints (TDS territory)
choice between alkaline and acid systems (bath-families KB)
emergency response steps (formal training)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a change in logged pH drift behavior or a TDS revision to window or trim chemicals

pros.claim: Knowing that acid gold pH drifts down by mechanism turns a scary trend into routine housekeeping
pros.example: the weekly log shows the same slow decline every week, so trimming becomes a scheduled small dose instead of a panic correction

cons.claim: pH moves efficiency, hardness and color together, so trimming it mid-batch changes the deposit the customer sees
cons.example: a trim between two halves of a bracelet order leaves the halves reading a shade apart against the plaque

failure_modes: trimming on an uncalibrated meter's reading
one large correction instead of stepwise trim, overshooting the far edge of the window
reaching for a strong mineral acid because the sanctioned trim is slow
acceptance_tests: for each bath the control card names the TDS trim chemicals for both directions and the log shows pH read at temperature with a calibration record for the meter
revisit_triggers: pH drift rate changes character (faster, or reversing direction) versus the logged norm
the TDS revises the window or the named trim chemicals

nodes.definition: Reason about temperature as one third of the bath's mass-transport budget alongside gold content and agitation: heat drives diffusion and reaction rate, so a bath running cold has a lower burning threshold - the current density that plated clean at setpoint burns edges when the heater lags - together with lower efficiency and slower build; a bath running hot consumes additives faster, evaporates harder, and in cyanide chemistry increases mist and vapor exposure and accelerates byproduct formation. The setpoint belongs to the TDS and the thermostat holds it, but thermostats fail silently: the control habit is an independent thermometer check against the controller on cadence, and a temperature reading logged with every session so a cold-morning burn can be told apart from a chemistry problem in one glance at the log.

included: temperature's effect on burning threshold, efficiency and additive consumption
independent thermometer verification against the thermostat
temperature in every log entry
excluded: numeric setpoints (TDS territory)
heater and equipment selection (equipment manufacturer instructions)
ventilation engineering (safety-compliance specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: disagreement between controller and independent thermometer, or a hardware change in the heating loop

pros.claim: A logged temperature with every session makes the cheapest parameter check the first suspect eliminated
pros.example: Monday's burnt batch resolves in one log line: the tank was well below setpoint because the timer never switched the heater on

cons.claim: Trusting the thermostat display without an independent check hides a drifting sensor for weeks
cons.example: a scaled-up heater probe reads at setpoint while the solution runs cool, and the burn signature gets blamed on gold content

failure_modes: plating into a bath still warming up because the schedule was tight
never verifying the controller against an independent thermometer
chasing a chemistry ghost for a defect that was a cold tank
acceptance_tests: the log shows a temperature for every plating session and a dated independent-thermometer verification on the cadence the control plan sets
revisit_triggers: controller and independent thermometer disagree beyond the shop's stated tolerance
heater, probe or controller hardware changes

nodes.definition: Treat agitation as a controlled parameter, not a knob to fiddle: solution movement replenishes the depleted film at the workpiece surface, so more agitation raises the usable current density ceiling while weak or blocked agitation shows up as gas streaks, dull stripes in flow shadows and burnt high-current corners at settings that used to plate clean. Because changing agitation silently rewrites the bath's whole current-density window, its class and setting come from the TDS, are recorded on the control card, and are changed deliberately with a note in the log - never casually mid-run. One family-specific hard line rides along from the safety envelope: air sparging is never improvised into a cyanide bath, because aerosolized mist is a cyanide exposure route and drawn-in air accelerates carbonate formation; the agitation class the TDS names is the one the tank gets.

included: agitation as usable-current-ceiling setter
weak-agitation deposit evidence
agitation as a recorded controlled parameter
no improvised air sparge in cyanide baths
excluded: part positioning and rack sway technique (process-execution specialist)
pump and equipment selection (equipment manufacturer instructions)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: deposit evidence of changed flow (streaks, shadows, shifted burn threshold) or an agitation hardware change

pros.claim: Naming agitation a controlled parameter stops the invisible window shifts that follow casual fiddling
pros.example: the log note stirrer raised one step explains why the next day's panel shows a shifted burning threshold, in seconds instead of a day of analysis

cons.claim: Fixed agitation can be wrong for an unusual piece geometry and the operator must notice, not just comply
cons.example: a deep-recessed pendant plates dull in its cavity at the standard stir rate; the answer is a process-execution fixturing question, not a secret bath problem

failure_modes: raising agitation mid-run to fix a defect and creating a new window nobody measured
an impeller fouled or misaligned so real agitation quietly fell while the setting stayed nominal
air sparge added to a cyanide bath for convenience
acceptance_tests: the control card states the TDS agitation class and setting, and every deliberate change appears in the log with its reason
revisit_triggers: gas streaks or flow-shadow dullness appear at settings that historically plated clean
agitation hardware changes

nodes.definition: Maintain the proprietary minor components the TDS doses but the bench cannot directly see: brighteners and grain refiners in all families, and in hard golds the hardener metal - the cobalt or nickel class - whose small window controls hardness and color together, so over-hardener trends brownish and brittle while depletion trends soft, dull and pale; in flash color baths the alloy-metal ratio drifts with every ampere-hour of use, which is why hue is checked against the retained plaque each shift. Because these components are proprietary and largely unanalyzable at the bench, their state is inferred from deposit evidence - Hull panel character, color against the plaque, coupon appearance - and replenished strictly per the TDS dosing rules or supplier lab instruction, never freelanced. Selecting which color system or hardener family to buy is the bath-families KB; this node keeps whichever one is in the tank in balance.

included: hardener-metal window as joint hardness-and-color control
additive state inferred from deposit evidence
TDS-ruled dosing of proprietary components
shiftly hue check against the retained plaque for color baths
excluded: hue recipe design and color-system selection (bath-families KB)
bench chemical analysis of proprietary formulations (supplier lab territory)
customer color-claim language (marking-compliance territory)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a plaque or panel change attributed to additive state, or a supplier revision of additive dosing

pros.claim: Treating color drift as the visible tip of additive drift catches the invisible components without owning a lab
pros.example: the shift plaque check reads a shade rosier than the retained standard, prompting a hardener-metal question to the supplier lab before a single order ships off-color

cons.claim: Inference from deposit evidence is indirect, so additive corrections are the easiest place to fool yourself
cons.example: dosing brightener into a haze that was actually early organic contamination brightens nothing and adds a variable to unpick later

failure_modes: freelance additive dosing beyond the TDS rules on a hunch
reading additive depletion when the true cause is contamination (lifecycle territory) and dosing anyway
skipping the shift plaque check on a color bath until a customer notices first
acceptance_tests: color baths show a logged shiftly plaque check, every additive dose in the log cites its TDS rule or supplier instruction, and no logged dose exceeds the TDS single-addition guidance
revisit_triggers: hue or brightness drifts against the retained reference two checks running
the supplier revises additive products or dosing rules
a Hull panel shows character change in the additive-sensitive current region

nodes.definition: In the alkaline family, hold free cyanide inside its TDS window as the complex-stability and adhesion guard: sufficient free cyanide keeps the gold complex stable, dissolves drag-in, and suppresses immersion (displacement) deposition - the smutty, non-adherent gold film that appears on work whose current was not on at entry when free cyanide runs low - while excess depresses cathode efficiency so plating slows at a given current. It is measured by the classic silver nitrate titration method class, itself a cyanide-handling task done under the segregation guard by a formally trained person, or sent to the supplier lab; it is restored only with the TDS-named cyanide salt in TDS-computed doses. Free cyanide also underwrites the family's safety chemistry: it exists safely only in strongly alkaline solution, tying this parameter permanently to the alkalinity floor.

included: free cyanide's stability and immersion-suppression roles
low and high consequences as deposit and rate evidence
titration under the segregation guard
TDS-only restoration
excluded: numeric concentration targets (TDS territory)
cyanide destruction and waste treatment (safety-compliance specialist)
strike-bath architecture decisions (bath-families KB)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: an adhesion or immersion-deposit event, or a lapse in the titration cadence

pros.claim: Knowing the immersion-smut signature saves adhesion failures from being misdiagnosed as prep failures
pros.example: gray smut on a piece that entered before the clip was live points at free cyanide and entry discipline, not at the cleaning line

cons.claim: The measurement itself carries handling risk and a training gate, so it gets deferred on busy weeks
cons.example: three skipped weekly titrations in a row is how a strike-adjacent build bath quietly loses its drag-in tolerance

failure_modes: titration deferred until an adhesion failure forces it
restoring free cyanide with anything but the TDS-named salt
an untrained hand running the titration to save time
acceptance_tests: free cyanide appears in the log on its cadence with the analyst's initials and training current, and every restoration dose cites the TDS arithmetic
revisit_triggers: an immersion-smut or adhesion event on alkaline-family work
the cadence lapses beyond its planned interval

nodes.definition: Track the byproduct the alkaline family generates just by existing: carbonate accumulates from cyanide oxidation and from the bath's absorption of carbon dioxide, and as it climbs past the product's service guidance - classic handbook practice flags dulling somewhere in the tens of grams per liter, commonly cited around the 60-to-90 band for the traditional baths - deposits go dull and hazy from a bath whose gold, free cyanide and pH all still measure in-window. That is precisely what makes it dangerous: it is the dull-for-no-visible-reason parameter. Control is measurement on the routine cadence plus the named countermeasure classes - chill freeze-out, where the bath is cooled so carbonate crystallizes out and is removed, or partial dump-and-refresh per supplier guidance. The judgment that a whole aged bath is beyond economic refresh belongs to the lifecycle KB; this node owns carbonate as a creeping, routinely measured number.

included: carbonate formation mechanism and creep
the in-window-but-dull signature
freeze-out and partial-refresh as method classes
carbonate on the routine analysis cadence
excluded: organic contamination and carbon treatment (lifecycle KB)
the retire-or-regenerate economics of an aged bath (lifecycle KB)
numeric service limits stated as universal (the product's own guidance governs)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a carbonate trend change or a dull-deposit event with in-window primary parameters

pros.claim: Carrying carbonate on the routine cadence explains the classic mystery dullness before it costs a customer batch
pros.example: the analysis sheet shows carbonate up again while everything else is flat, matching the operator's dull low-current note from Tuesday

cons.claim: Freeze-out and partial refresh are disruptive tank-scale operations that tempt deferral
cons.example: a chilled overnight freeze-out means a tank out of service; shops defer it until dullness is already visible on parts

failure_modes: chasing additive or contamination ghosts for a dullness that is carbonate creep
never measuring carbonate because gold and cyanide are the glamorous numbers
running freeze-out without supplier guidance on re-adjusting the bath afterward
acceptance_tests: carbonate appears in the routine analysis record for every alkaline-family bath and any countermeasure run cites the supplier's procedure and is followed by a re-analysis
revisit_triggers: dullness with an otherwise in-window analysis
carbonate trend slope changes versus the log's history

nodes.definition: Operate the symptom-to-parameter map that turns a deposit change into a testable hypothesis: burnt brown edges and matte high-current points read as current density above the bath's present ceiling - which may mean low gold, a cold tank or weak agitation before it means wrong rectifier settings; overall dullness or haze from a previously good bath reads as carbonate load, additive depletion, or contamination that belongs to the lifecycle KB to treat and to this map to recognize; paler, greener or rosier color in a hard or color gold reads as hardener-metal or pH drift; smutty non-adherent film reads as immersion deposition from low free cyanide or dead entry; a sliding thickness-per-ampere-minute reads as falling efficiency. Every signature ends in the same discipline: name the measurement that would confirm or kill the hypothesis, because dosing on a symptom without that measurement is how one drifted parameter becomes three.

included: symptom classes mapped to candidate parameter causes
each signature closed by its confirming measurement
recognition of when a symptom points outside this KB (contamination, prep, execution)
excluded: treating contamination (lifecycle KB)
prep-failure diagnosis (surface-prep specialist)
full defect cause trees on finished goods (quality specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a misdiagnosis post-mortem or a symptom class the current map cannot place

pros.claim: A shared signature vocabulary lets the whole shop triage a defect the same way in one minute
pros.example: burnt edges, cold morning, big pieces - the map sends the operator to the thermometer and the gold titration before anyone touches a knob

cons.claim: Signatures overlap, and the map invites overconfident single-cause reading
cons.example: dull haze is carbonate, depleted brightener and early organics all at once on paper; only measurement separates them, and excursions travel in packs

failure_modes: dosing on a signature without the confirming measurement
reading a prep or fixturing defect as bath drift and correcting a healthy bath
stopping at the first plausible cause when two parameters moved together
acceptance_tests: for each symptom class the shop's map names at least two candidate causes and the specific measurement that separates them, and the log shows corrections preceded by that measurement
revisit_triggers: a diagnosed cause turns out wrong after correction
a new symptom class appears that the map does not cover
a sibling-KB boundary case (contamination, prep) is misrouted through this map

nodes.definition: Run the small set of leading indicators that catch drift while it is still invisible in accepted parts: the color check of a standard piece or plaque against the retained reference at the start of each shift; cell voltage at a fixed current on a fixed fixture, whose creep flags conductivity, contact or chemistry change; the first-article coupon on jobs that matter; the thickness-per-ampere-minute trend computed from the log; and the periodic Hull panel held against baseline. Sentinels carry alert bands derived from the baseline artifacts and the log's normal scatter - set too tight they cry wolf until nobody listens, set too loose they fire only after scrap exists. A fired sentinel triggers targeted analysis, never a reflex dose: its whole value is buying the time to measure before correcting.

included: the sentinel set and what each is sensitive to
alert bands derived from baseline and log scatter
sentinel-to-analysis (never sentinel-to-dose) routing
excluded: final QC acceptance of finished goods (quality specialist)
statistical process control formalism beyond band-setting from logged scatter

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: false-alarm or missed-drift counts crossing the review threshold, or a re-baselining event

pros.claim: Sentinels convert drift from a scrap event into a maintenance note
pros.example: the shift plaque reads at the edge of its band on Wednesday; the targeted analysis and small trim happen Thursday; the Friday wedding-band order never knows

cons.claim: Sentinels cost a few minutes every shift forever, and their value is invisible when nothing is drifting
cons.example: six quiet weeks tempt the shop to drop the voltage check - the seventh week is when the contact corrosion would have been caught

failure_modes: alert bands set from wishful thinking instead of logged scatter
a fired sentinel answered with a dose instead of a measurement
sentinel checks silently dropped under schedule pressure
acceptance_tests: each sentinel has a written alert band citing the baseline or log data it derives from, and the log shows sentinel results each shift with analyses triggered by any band edge
revisit_triggers: two false alarms or one missed drift in a rolling review window
baseline re-established after a major correction, invalidating derived bands

nodes.definition: Operate the wet-bench method class that puts numbers on the parameters the TDS windows: the silver nitrate titration for free cyanide, supplier test-kit titrations for gold or hardener metal where the product line offers them, carbonate determination, and the pH meter calibrated against buffer standards and read at bath temperature. Know what the class can and cannot see: titrations measure concentrations, not proprietary additives and not deposit quality; a result is only as good as its sample - drawn from a mixed, at-temperature bath, never from a stagnant corner or right after an addition - and only as good as the calibration behind the instrument. Results are judged against the TDS window, logged with method and temperature, and cyanide-side work happens under the segregation guard with formal training; a wet result that contradicts deposit evidence goes to arbitration, not to the dosing spoon.

included: titration and meter method classes with calibration discipline
sampling rules for representative results
what wet analysis is blind to
logging results against TDS windows
excluded: instrument-specific procedures (the kit's own instructions govern)
proprietary additive quantification (supplier lab)
spectroscopic lab methods the bench does not own

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a contradicted wet result traced to sampling or calibration, or a change in available bench methods

pros.claim: Same-day numbers on the primary parameters keep control decisions inside the shop's own loop
pros.example: a lunchtime gold titration confirms the burn hypothesis and the TDS-computed replenisher dose goes in before the afternoon batch

cons.claim: Wet numbers look authoritative even when sampling or calibration quietly broke
cons.example: a titration on a sample drawn beside the just-dosed corner reads high and talks the operator out of the addition the bath actually needed

failure_modes: sampling a stagnant or freshly dosed region
pH read cold and compared against an at-temperature window
skipping buffer calibration until readings drift into fiction
acceptance_tests: every logged wet result carries method, sample time relative to additions, and temperature, and the meter shows a current calibration record
revisit_triggers: a wet result contradicted by deposit evidence or by the supplier lab
new test kits or a new product line change the available methods

nodes.definition: Use the Hull cell as the bath's one-shot current-density sweep: a single trapezoidal panel plates the whole low-to-high current density range at once, so additive imbalance, contamination haze, burning-threshold shifts and low-current dullness appear as patterns along the panel that no concentration titration can show. Read panels comparatively - today's against the commissioning baseline panel, and before-versus-after around every correction - because absolute panel interpretation is deep supplier lore while what-changed reading is honest bench work. Respect its limits: panel agitation, temperature control and geometry differ from the production tank, so a clean panel does not certify production and a strange panel does not name a concentration; the panel is diagnostic evidence that routes to wet analysis or the supplier lab, and its plating and rinsing obey the same zone rules as any other cyanide- or acid-side operation.

included: the panel as a full-range deposit behavior snapshot
comparative reading against baseline and around corrections
panel limits versus the production tank
excluded: quantitative concentration inference from panels
production release decisions on panel evidence alone
electro-cell theory beyond bench use

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a panel-versus-production disagreement or a superseded baseline panel

pros.claim: One panel shows the whole current-density story that a dozen plated parts would only sample
pros.example: the panel's high-current end burns earlier than baseline while titrations sit mid-window, pointing at mass transport rather than concentration a day before parts would have shown it

cons.claim: Panel conditions are not tank conditions, and forgetting that turns a diagnostic into a false certificate
cons.example: a clean panel from a well-stirred cell blesses a bath whose production tank has a fouled impeller; the parts still streak

failure_modes: reading a single panel in isolation with no baseline beside it
treating a clean panel as production release evidence
uncontrolled panel temperature or agitation making runs incomparable
acceptance_tests: panels are labeled with bath, date and conditions, filed beside the baseline panel, and every correction in the log has a before-and-after panel pair where the protocol calls for one
revisit_triggers: panel evidence and production parts disagree
the baseline panel is superseded by a re-baselining event

nodes.definition: Prove what the bath actually delivers with a plated witness coupon on the standard substrate measured by XRF: thickness at known ampere-minutes yields the bath's working current efficiency and, tracked over time, its trend - the quiet slide that makes time-based recipes under-deposit as a bath ages; coupon appearance gives color and brightness on a controlled surface independent of any customer piece's prep history. Coupons are the arbitration evidence when solution analysis says healthy but parts say sick, the mandatory verification after any crash correction, and the first-article gate on high-stakes jobs. XRF access may be an owned instrument or a send-out service; either way the bench must understand the method class - geometry sensitivity, calibration standards, spot size - well enough to know when a reading is trustworthy and when it is an artifact.

included: coupon protocol at known area, current and time
XRF thickness as efficiency evidence and its trend
coupon as arbitration and post-correction verification
excluded: final-goods thickness certification and claim language (quality and compliance specialists)
XRF instrument physics beyond bench-relevant limits
per-job thickness delivery decisions (process-execution specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: an efficiency-trend excursion or a change in the XRF measurement path

pros.claim: The coupon measures the only thing the customer ultimately buys - the deposit - so it outranks every solution number
pros.example: titrations all mid-window, yet the coupon shows thickness-per-ampere-minute down by a fifth against baseline; the recipe times get corrected before the next batch under-plates

cons.claim: Coupon-and-XRF cycles cost time and access, so pressure builds to trust solution numbers alone between checks
cons.example: a send-out XRF turnaround of days tempts the shop to stretch coupon intervals exactly when an aging bath needs them shortest

failure_modes: coupons plated under uncontrolled conditions and read as if standard
XRF readings trusted blind on unsuitable geometry or a stale calibration
efficiency trend never computed, so the drift hides inside job-by-job noise
acceptance_tests: each coupon in the file carries substrate, area, current, time and date, the XRF path (instrument or service) is named with its calibration status, and the efficiency trend chart is current in the log
revisit_triggers: efficiency trend crosses the shop's stated action band
coupon evidence contradicts solution analysis
the XRF instrument, service or calibration standard changes

nodes.definition: Use the chemistry supplier's analytical service as the authoritative instrument the bench does not own: full analysis of gold, additive package and trace metallic contaminants, interpreted by the party that formulated the product and returned as correction instructions tied to the actual TDS. Escalate on defined triggers - bench methods disagreeing persistently after arbitration, a proprietary additive implicated by deposit evidence, an indicated correction larger than routine dosing, or the routine deep-check interval - and do it properly: sample per the supplier's instruction, representative and labeled with bath identity, volume and history; ship per the rules your jurisdiction applies to the chemistry class; send the relevant log excerpt with the sample. Treat the returned report as an instruction set executed per TDS and then re-baseline, because a bath after a supplier-directed correction is chemically a new bath wearing an old name.

included: escalation triggers
sampling, labeling and lawful shipping discipline
executing the report per TDS and re-baselining after
excluded: the supplier's internal methods
regenerate-versus-retire economics (lifecycle KB)
second-guessing the formulator's correction with bench improvisation

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a supplier service change or a lab report that contradicts the bench picture

pros.claim: The formulator sees the whole composition at once, which no combination of bench methods can
pros.example: the report that explains three weeks of haze in one line - a trace metallic plus a depleted carrier - after the bench had correctly measured everything the bench could measure

cons.claim: Turnaround and cost make the lab a poor tool for routine questions and a bottleneck under deadline
cons.example: a week's round trip on a sample while a drifting tank either sits idle or keeps plating on hope

failure_modes: an unrepresentative or unlabeled sample wasting the round trip
shipping a cyanide-bearing sample outside the jurisdiction's rules
cherry-picking the report's easy lines and skipping the correction that needed downtime
acceptance_tests: each escalation in the log shows its trigger, the sampling and shipping route used, the report received, the corrections executed per TDS, and the re-baseline that followed
revisit_triggers: a report contradicting the shop's bench picture (calibration audit due)
the supplier changes its service, sampling instructions or product line

nodes.definition: Adjudicate when evidence about the same bath disagrees - titration says in-window but the deposit is wrong, the Hull panel is clean but production parts fail, bookkeeping predicts consumption that analysis does not show. The ladder: first suspect the measurement, checking calibration, sampling and arithmetic before touching the bath; second, repeat with a fresh, properly drawn sample; third, bring an independent method class to the same question - a coupon arbitrates a titration, a panel arbitrates an eyeball, an at-temperature meter arbitrates a cold reading; fourth, if disagreement survives, the supplier lab arbitrates, and until it does nothing is dosed except what safety itself requires. The discipline this node exists to kill has a name in every plating shop's history: correcting a healthy bath on a broken meter's word, which is how one bad reading becomes a dead bath.

included: the four-rung arbitration ladder
no-dosing-during-arbitration rule with the safety exception
which method classes arbitrate which
excluded: the individual methods themselves (their own nodes)
supplier lab internals
statistical measurement theory beyond bench discipline

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: an arbitration that misfired or a recurring disagreement pattern between two specific methods

pros.claim: A fixed ladder makes the humble move - doubt your own instrument - the standard move instead of the heroic one
pros.example: the pH meter that reads a healthy acid bath low is caught at rung one by its failed buffer check, before the alkali dose that would have overshot the true window

cons.claim: The ladder costs time while a tank sits in limbo and jobs queue
cons.example: two days of repeat-sample-and-coupon on a disagreement that turns out to be a mislabeled sample bottle - cheaper than the alternative, but not free

failure_modes: dosing to split the difference between two disagreeing numbers
skipping the calibration rung because the instrument is new or trusted
letting deadline pressure declare a winner instead of the ladder
acceptance_tests: every logged disagreement shows the rungs climbed in order, what each found, and no bath addition between detection and resolution except safety-required ones
revisit_triggers: an arbitration outcome that the ladder ordering handled badly
a recurring disagreement pair suggesting a systematic method problem

nodes.definition: Keep the consumption ledger that predicts replenishment before analysis confirms it: deposited gold is charge-driven - Faraday's proportionality between ampere-minutes and metal, taken as a mechanism to reason with rather than a memorized constant - so logged ampere-minutes times the bath's measured efficiency estimate the gold that left with the work, and the TDS or supplier arithmetic converts that into the replenisher dose. The governing rule is that bookkeeping predicts and analysis confirms: the two are reconciled on the control cadence, and a growing gap between predicted and measured consumption is itself a diagnostic - efficiency drifting with bath age, surface-area estimates off, or losses the log never saw. Never let the arithmetic replace measurement: dose-by-calculation alone inherits every error in the efficiency it assumes, and inherits it compounded.

included: ampere-minute capture and charge-based consumption estimation
prediction-versus-analysis reconciliation
the prediction gap as a diagnostic signal
excluded: surface-area estimation technique per piece (process-execution specialist)
drag-out loss reduction (lifecycle KB)
gold pricing and job costing (business specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a widening prediction gap or a superseding efficiency measurement

pros.claim: Prediction converts replenishment from reactive rescue into scheduled housekeeping
pros.example: the ledger flags that Thursday's chain batch will take the bath near its low edge, so the dose is measured, computed and ready before the batch runs

cons.claim: The arithmetic is only as good as the efficiency and area numbers fed to it, and both drift
cons.example: an acid hard gold running months old plates a fraction of what the make-up-day efficiency predicts; unreconciled, the ledger starves the bath on schedule

failure_modes: dosing on prediction alone for weeks without an analysis reconciliation
ampere-minutes unlogged on small jobs that add up
an efficiency figure from commissioning used long after the trend moved
acceptance_tests: the ledger shows ampere-minutes per job, the efficiency figure in use with its source coupon and date, scheduled reconciliations against analysis, and the current prediction-gap trend
revisit_triggers: the prediction gap widens beyond the shop's stated band
a new efficiency measurement supersedes the figure in use

nodes.definition: Replenish in small, frequent, measured additions that keep every parameter near the center of its window, instead of running to an edge and correcting in one heroic dose: small adds keep the deposit the customer sees constant run to run, are individually cheap to verify, and leave a log trail in which cause and effect stay attached to each other. The loop is fixed: measure - or reconcile the bookkeeping - first; add the TDS-named product in the TDS-computed amount; mix to homogeneity; re-verify before the next job that matters; and hold to one variable per correction cycle unless the supplier's own procedure explicitly couples adjustments. The asymmetry that justifies the discipline is physical: an addition cannot be poured back out, and gold salt especially is money dissolved irreversibly into the tank, so the cheap error is always the too-small dose.

included: the measure-add-mix-verify loop
one-variable-per-cycle discipline
TDS-computed dose sizing
the irreversibility asymmetry favoring small doses
excluded: out-of-window rescue (crash protocol node)
additive inference (additive node)
dose chemistry not named by the TDS (never)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a failed post-dose verification or a dose-frequency trend change

pros.claim: Small frequent doses make bath state a flat line instead of a sawtooth, which is what color consistency is made of
pros.example: the vermeil-class regulars reorder because June's bracelet matches February's - the bath never wandered far enough from center to show

cons.claim: Frequent small additions mean frequent small opportunities for procedure error
cons.example: ten doses a month is ten chances to grab the strike replenisher instead of the build replenisher; label discipline and the log carry the load

failure_modes: dosing before measuring because the bookkeeping looked convincing
two products added in one cycle so the next drift has two suspects
an unmixed addition sampled early and corrected twice
acceptance_tests: every addition in the log is preceded by a measurement or reconciliation, sized by TDS arithmetic, followed by a verification, and touches one variable unless a supplier procedure is cited
revisit_triggers: a verification failing after a routine dose
dose frequency climbing beyond the historical norm for the workload

nodes.definition: Run the out-of-window response when drift has become an excursion: customer work stops on that tank immediately; the full parameter set is measured, not just the suspect one, because excursions travel in packs; corrections go stepwise per the TDS and supplier guidance, the safety-relevant parameter first, one variable at a time with mixing and re-measurement between steps; and the bath re-earns service on evidence - a Hull panel and a witness coupon read against baseline - never on the feeling that it should be fine now. The protocol knows its own boundary: a bath that will not come back inside its windows after the TDS's own corrections, or whose root problem is contamination or age, leaves this KB's scope for the supplier lab and for the lifecycle KB's regenerate-or-retire decision - pouring more correction into it is not maintenance, it is denial.

included: stop-work trigger on any out-of-window measurement
full-set measurement before correction
stepwise TDS-governed correction order
evidence-based return to service
the handoff boundary to supplier and lifecycle decisions
excluded: contamination treatment itself (lifecycle KB)
regenerate-versus-retire economics (lifecycle KB)
any correction chemistry the TDS does not sanction

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a recurring excursion or a correction sequence that failed to restore the window

pros.claim: A pre-agreed protocol removes the worst decision - keep plating while we figure it out - from the menu
pros.example: the anniversary-ring order waits a day on a stopped tank instead of shipping off-color from a bath mid-correction and coming back as a complaint

cons.claim: Stop-work has real cost and invites pressure to shave the protocol
cons.example: a stopped build tank on a trade-account deadline tests whether the shop's rules outrank the shop's phone

failure_modes: correcting the one measured parameter while its unmeasured companions drift on
big-bang multi-variable correction that cannot be attributed afterward
returning to service on elapsed time instead of panel-and-coupon evidence
endless correction of a bath whose problem is lifecycle, not window
acceptance_tests: each excursion in the log shows the stop, the full-set measurement, stepwise corrections each citing TDS or supplier guidance, and the panel-and-coupon evidence on which service resumed
revisit_triggers: an excursion recurring within the shop's review window after correction
a correction sequence that failed to restore the window (escalation due)

nodes.definition: Fix who checks what, when, on each tank: the per-session checks (temperature, the sentinel set, pH where the TDS asks for it that often), the periodic wet analyses on a schedule scaled from TDS guidance and actual workload, panel and coupon checks on their own interval and around every correction, and the supplier deep-check interval for what the bench cannot see. Cadence scales with stakes and use - a heavily worked tank or one feeding high-value orders is measured more often than a quiet one - and it tightens automatically after any excursion or failed release check, relaxing back only after a stated stretch of stability re-earns the routine schedule. A cadence nobody owns is not a cadence: every line carries a name, and the log is the proof it happened rather than the intention it would.

included: the cadence table per tank with owners
workload- and stakes-based scaling
automatic tightening after excursions and relaxation rules
excluded: numeric frequencies asserted as universal (TDS guidance plus logged workload set them)
staff scheduling and HR matters
QC cadence on finished goods (quality specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a workload shift, an excursion-driven tightening, or an audit finding skipped checks

pros.claim: A named owner per check is the difference between a cadence and a wish
pros.example: the free-cyanide titration stopped being sometimes-skipped the week it moved from someone should onto one person's Tuesday list

cons.claim: A cadence tuned to average weeks under-measures the abnormal ones
cons.example: a holiday rush doubles ampere-minutes while the analysis schedule sleeps through it; workload-scaling has to be actually recomputed, not just intended

failure_modes: cadence lines with no owner quietly not happening
a fixed calendar cadence ignoring a workload surge
cadence never tightening after an excursion because nobody is assigned to tighten it
acceptance_tests: each tank's cadence table names every check, interval, owner and the tightening rule, and a log audit shows the checks happening at the stated intervals
revisit_triggers: workload shifts materially versus the cadence's assumptions
an excursion or failed release check fires the tightening rule

nodes.definition: Gate customer work on bath health: before a job enters the tank, the release record shows the current-cadence measurements inside their TDS windows, no unresolved sentinel alarms, no correction still open, and - for high-stakes work like heirloom pieces, trade-account batches or color-critical orders - a first-article coupon or witness from the bath's present state. A bath under crash correction, holding a disagreement still in arbitration, or overdue on its cadence does not take customer work, whatever the deadline says. The gate is this KB's promise to the customer compressed into one checkpoint: every color, karat and quality claim downstream stands on a bath demonstrably in-window at the moment of plating, and a job pushed into an unproven bath is not saved time - it is rework wearing a rush order's name.

included: release conditions per job class
hold states (open correction, live arbitration, overdue cadence)
first-article evidence for high-stakes work
excluded: piece readiness (surface-prep specialist's gate)
final QC acceptance and claims (quality and compliance specialists)
customer communication about delay (business specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a defect escaping a passed gate or a new job class needing its own release conditions

pros.claim: One checkpoint converts all upstream discipline into a customer-facing guarantee
pros.example: when a vermeil-class claim is questioned months later, the release record plus coupon file answers it with dated evidence instead of recollection

cons.claim: The gate concentrates schedule pain at the exact moment pressure is highest
cons.example: a same-day repair promise meets an overdue titration; the honest answer is an hour's delay, and the gate must be built to survive that phone call

failure_modes: verbal release with no record because everyone was sure
high-stakes work released without first-article evidence
the gate silently weakening under repeat deadline pressure until it is decoration
acceptance_tests: every customer job's record cites the tank's release evidence (in-window measurements with dates, no open holds) and first-article evidence where the job class demands it
revisit_triggers: any defect escaping through a passed gate
job classes changing (new high-stakes work types) requiring new release conditions

edges.why_related: the baseline transcribes the TDS windows onto the control card and measures the fresh bath against them
the log continues the record the commissioning baseline opens; entry zero is the make-up record
the gold window and the sanctioned replenisher the mechanism reasoning defers to come from the TDS
free-cyanide measurement and dosing are cyanide-handling tasks that exist only inside the segregation envelope
the burn-signature entries of the map are the gold-supply mechanism read backward from the deposit
the color-and-efficiency drift entries of the map lean on what pH does per family class
hue and brightness signatures decode into hardener and additive state through this mechanism node
sentinels are chosen to be the earliest observable edge of the signatures the map catalogs
a wet result only means something judged against the TDS window it is compared to
comparative panel reading requires the healthy baseline panel the commissioning produced
efficiency trending starts from the baseline coupon's thickness-per-ampere-minute reference
arbitration presumes the wet methods and their calibration discipline as the first rung it audits
the coupon is the independent deposit-truth rung the arbitration ladder climbs to
the supplier lab is the ladder's last rung; escalation triggers are defined by arbitration outcomes
consumption prediction runs on the ampere-minutes and additions the log captures per job
the bookkeeping's predictions set the timing and sizing that little-and-often dosing verifies and executes
the crash protocol's full-set measurement and correction order are guided by the map's cause structure
the cadence table schedules the sentinel set and reacts to what the sentinels report
the gate's in-window evidence is defined as the current-cadence measurement set being present and passing

pH floors are safety lines and trim chemistry is restricted: no strong acid near cyanide-bearing baths, TDS-named trims only
edges.risk_of_conflict: treating a pH floor as an optimization target instead of a hard line

edges.why_related: cyanide-side titration is itself a cyanide-handling task: trained hands, zoned equipment, segregated sample ware
crash corrections may use only TDS-sanctioned chemicals and supplier-guided steps, however dire the excursion
every routine dose is the TDS-named product at the TDS-computed amount; the discipline has no other inputs
a cold tank lowers the burning threshold, producing the burnt-edge signature at a current that was safe at setpoint

carbonate creep causes the dull-with-in-window-primaries signature that anchors one branch of the map
