edges.resolution_rule: little-and-often governs while every parameter measures inside its TDS window; the moment any parameter measures outside, the crash protocol takes over, customer work stops, and routine dosing is suspended until service is re-earned on panel-and-coupon evidence

edges.why_related: a confident signature reading tempts the operator to dose on the symptom without waiting for the confirming measurement
edges.resolution_rule: a signature only ever forms a hypothesis; no addition enters the tank until a measurement confirms it - the one act a symptom alone justifies is stopping work on that tank

edges.why_related: lab authority against bench turnaround: waiting a week for the lab idles the tank, acting on bench numbers risks acting on less than the truth
edges.resolution_rule: bench methods govern routine window checks; the supplier lab wins whenever bench methods persistently disagree after arbitration, a proprietary additive is implicated, or the indicated correction exceeds routine dosing - and the tank takes no customer work while the question it asked the lab is open

edges.why_related: the chemically fastest downward pH fix is a strong mineral acid, exactly what segregation forbids anywhere near cyanide-bearing chemistry
edges.resolution_rule: segregation wins absolutely: pH is trimmed only with the trim chemical the TDS names, in the bath's own zone, and a pH problem that the sanctioned trim cannot fix escalates to the supplier rather than to a stronger bottle

edges.why_related: a failed or near-failed release check fires the cadence-tightening rule on that tank
each measured thickness-per-ampere-minute updates the efficiency figure the consumption ledger runs on
after a supplier-directed correction the bath is re-baselined: new reference panel, coupon and control-card state
a fired sentinel is followed by targeted wet analysis before any corrective action is considered
a corrected bath is proven on a witness coupon (with its panel) before it re-enters service
both read the deposit itself on a standard substrate rather than the solution - the panel across a current sweep, the coupon at one known operating point

conflict_axes.name: deadline_throughput_vs_bath_verification
conflict_axes.description: Jobs queue and promises age while measurements, coupons and gates take bench time; the pressure to plate now and verify later is constant and cumulative.
poles: plate the job now
prove the bath first
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the release gate wins: safety and evidenced quality beat deadline everywhere they meet, and a delayed honest job costs less than a fast defective one

conflict_axes.name: symptom_dosing_vs_measured_dosing
conflict_axes.description: A recognizable drift signature invites immediate correction, but signatures overlap and dosing on the wrong hypothesis stacks a second drifted variable on the first.
poles: dose on what the deposit looks like
dose only on a confirming measurement
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the signature selects which measurement to run; the measurement authorizes the dose; the only act a symptom alone justifies is stopping work

conflict_axes.name: little_and_often_vs_crash_correction
conflict_axes.description: Steady small additions keep the deposit constant but feel fussy; letting the bath run to an edge and correcting hard feels efficient but trades color consistency and attributability for the feeling.
poles: small frequent centered corrections
infrequent large edge rescues
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: little-and-often is the default inside the window; outside the window the crash protocol governs; a shop repeatedly needing crash corrections has a cadence problem, not a chemistry problem

conflict_axes.name: bench_speed_vs_lab_authority
conflict_axes.description: Bench methods answer today with limited eyes; the supplier lab answers next week with the formulator's full sight - and the tank has jobs waiting either way.
poles: act on bench numbers today
wait for the supplier lab's authority
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: bench for routine window-keeping, lab for persistent disagreement, proprietary components and large corrections; while a lab question is open the tank takes no customer work

conflict_axes.name: gold_inventory_cost_vs_in_window_robustness
conflict_axes.description: Every gram of gold in solution is locked capital, so lean running tempts; but low-edge operation narrows the usable current window and turns ordinary variance into burn scrap.
poles: run lean near the low edge to free capital
run mid-window for operating margin
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: lean running is a deliberate, documented choice at the low edge of the TDS window priced against burn-scrap risk; below the window it is not a choice, it is an excursion

conflict_axes.name: segregation_absolutism_vs_bench_convenience
conflict_axes.description: Duplicate meters, zoned sample ware and decontamination steps cost time and money every single day, and the hazard they answer is invisible until the one day it is not.
poles: absolute zone separation with duplicated gear
shared equipment with careful habits
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: segregation is absolute and non-negotiable: the cyanide-acid line is a life-safety boundary, and convenience never buys an exception

conflict_axes.name: tds_generality_vs_logged_shop_experience
conflict_axes.description: The TDS window is generic across every customer of the product; the shop's log knows where in that window this tank, this work mix and this water run best.
poles: operate anywhere the TDS allows
operate where the log says this bath is happiest
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the log refines position inside the window and never overrides its edges or the safety floors; a logged sweet spot is documented on the control card as a shop preference, not a new window

conflict_axes.name: sentinel_sensitivity_vs_alarm_fatigue
conflict_axes.description: Tight sentinel bands catch drift early but fire on noise until the shop stops listening; loose bands stay credible but fire after scrap already exists.
poles: tight bands, early catches, frequent alarms
loose bands, credible alarms, later catches
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: derive bands from the baseline and the log's measured scatter, then review after every false alarm and every missed drift - the band is a maintained artifact, not a guess

conflict_axes.name: logging_thoroughness_vs_bench_pace
conflict_axes.description: Every field in a log entry costs seconds on every job forever, and the log's value arrives weeks later on the day something goes wrong.
poles: complete entries at the moment of the event
minimal notes to keep the bench moving
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the minimum record set is non-negotiable because it is the evidence base everything else stands on; streamline the form and the habit, never the content

conflict_axes.name: single_variable_discipline_vs_downtime_pressure
conflict_axes.description: Correcting one parameter per cycle with re-measurement between is slow while a tank is down; fixing everything at once restarts production but destroys attributability the moment anything is still wrong.
poles: one change per cycle, measured between
combined correction, faster restart
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: one variable per cycle unless the supplier's own procedure explicitly couples adjustments; the time saved by a shotgun correction is borrowed at interest from the next diagnosis

edge_cases.description: The deposit is dull but gold, free cyanide and pH all measure inside their windows
edge_cases.trigger: a symptom with no out-of-window primary parameter
edge_cases.mitigation: check the unglamorous parameters - carbonate in alkaline baths, additive state via a panel against baseline - and if evidence points at organics, route to the lifecycle KB's contamination treatment instead of dosing anything here

edge_cases.description: Burnt edges appear only on the largest pieces while small work plates clean
edge_cases.mitigation: suspect current density and area estimation - an execution-side variable - before bath chemistry; measure gold and temperature to rule the bath in or out, and hand the area question to the process-execution side rather than dosing

edge_cases.description: A pH correction is about to be made on a meter whose last buffer calibration nobody can date
edge_cases.trigger: an instrument-driven correction with a stale calibration
edge_cases.mitigation: calibrate first, re-measure, and only then correct; a correction on an unverified instrument is treated as dosing blind and is barred by the arbitration ladder's first rung

edge_cases.description: The acid hard gold's pH has crept down again a week after the last trim
edge_cases.trigger: recurring downward drift in normal acid-gold service
edge_cases.mitigation: recognize the anodic acid-generation mechanism as expected behavior: schedule small stepwise trims with the TDS-named alkali on cadence instead of treating each recurrence as a fault

edge_cases.description: An alkaline cyanide bath is found reading near its alkalinity floor
edge_cases.trigger: alkalinity approaching the safety line rather than a quality edge
edge_cases.mitigation: treat as a safety event first: stop work, ensure ventilation, restore alkalinity per the TDS with the sanctioned alkali only, never any acid anywhere in the sequence, and review how the floor was approached before the tank returns to service

edge_cases.description: A flash color bath reads a shade off against the retained plaque at the shift check
edge_cases.trigger: hue drift on a lean alloyed color bath
edge_cases.mitigation: hold color-critical work, confirm with a second plaque under the standard light, and correct alloy balance only per TDS or supplier instruction - hue recipes are proprietary, and redesigning the color system belongs to the bath-families KB

edge_cases.description: Two different products were added in one correction cycle and the deposit changed
edge_cases.trigger: a multi-variable addition with an unattributable outcome
edge_cases.mitigation: log the breach honestly, stop further additions, and re-establish state by full analysis plus panel and coupon before the next dose; treat the event as a procedure failure to review, not just a chemistry puzzle

edge_cases.description: Thickness-per-ampere-minute has slid so far that the standard recipe times under-deposit
edge_cases.trigger: efficiency drift with bath age invalidating time-based recipes
edge_cases.mitigation: re-measure efficiency on a coupon, update the ledger's figure and the recipe times from measurement, and flag persistent decline to the supplier lab and the lifecycle assessment

edge_cases.description: The Hull panel looks like baseline but production parts still come out defective
edge_cases.mitigation: remember the panel's geometry and agitation are not the tank's: run a witness coupon on the production fixture and inspect tank-side variables (flow, contacts, racking) before concluding anything about chemistry

edge_cases.description: A new drum of replenisher arrives with a different product version on the label
edge_cases.trigger: a product or TDS revision entering the shop unannounced
edge_cases.mitigation: stop dosing from the new drum until its TDS is read and compared; if windows or dosing arithmetic changed, update the control card and re-baseline as the supplier directs - never dose the new product on the old product's numbers

edge_cases.description: An analysis sample was drawn minutes after an addition, near the dosing point
edge_cases.trigger: an unrepresentative sample entering the decision loop
edge_cases.mitigation: discard the result, re-sample from a mixed at-temperature bath after the TDS mixing interval, and log sample timing relative to additions so the error is visible next time

edge_cases.description: A tank idle for weeks is wanted for a job this afternoon
edge_cases.trigger: return-to-service after an idle period with evaporation and settling
edge_cases.mitigation: no release on memory of past health: bring to temperature, restore level per the TDS make-up rules, run the full analysis set plus a panel or coupon against baseline, and only then open the gate

workflow.action: Anchor every number to the TDS
workflow.description: Transcribe each tank's controlled parameters, windows and sanctioned chemicals from the product TDS onto a control card
workflow.artifact: per-tank control card citing the TDS revision
workflow.gate: every controlled parameter has a TDS-sourced window and no number lacks a source

workflow.action: Set the safety envelope for all analysis and dosing
workflow.description: Establish zoned equipment, storage, drains and training gates for cyanide-side and acid-side work
workflow.artifact: posted segregation and handling rules with the training record
workflow.gate: cyanide and acid zones, storage and drains are separate and labeled, and the training record covers everyone who samples or doses

workflow.action: Commission the bath and capture its baseline
workflow.description: Record make-up, run the initial analysis, and produce the baseline panel, coupon and color plaque
workflow.artifact: dated commissioning record with labeled reference artifacts
workflow.gate: the baseline exists complete before the first customer job

workflow.description: Start the per-tank entry stream with the minimum record set and the at-the-moment rule
workflow.artifact: live bath log seeded with the commissioning entry
workflow.gate: the minimum record set is defined and the first week's entries carry it

workflow.description: For each TDS-controlled parameter, write what it does, what its drift looks like on parts, and which measurement confirms it
workflow.gate: every TDS-listed parameter has a card with mechanism, drift evidence and confirming measurement

workflow.action: Stand up the bench analysis methods
workflow.description: Establish the titrations, kits and meter calibration discipline, plus Hull cell and coupon practice against baseline
workflow.artifact: method sheets with calibration records and sampling rules
workflow.gate: each method has a sheet, a calibration state and a stated blind spot list

workflow.action: Wire the sentinels into every shift
workflow.description: Define the sentinel set with alert bands derived from baseline artifacts and log scatter
workflow.artifact: sentinel checklist with derived alert bands
workflow.gate: every sentinel band cites the baseline or log data it derives from

workflow.description: Capture ampere-minutes per job and run charge-based consumption prediction reconciled against analysis
workflow.artifact: consumption ledger with the current efficiency figure and its source
workflow.gate: predictions reconcile against analysis on schedule and the gap trend is tracked

workflow.description: Execute the measure-add-mix-verify loop with TDS-computed doses, one variable per cycle
workflow.artifact: dated addition entries closing each loop
workflow.gate: every addition is preceded by a measurement and followed by a verification

workflow.action: Define the crash-correction protocol before it is needed
workflow.description: Write the out-of-window response: stop work, full-set measurement, stepwise TDS-governed correction, evidence-based return
workflow.gate: the protocol names the stop trigger, the correction order rule and the return-to-service evidence

workflow.action: Schedule the control cadence with owners
workflow.description: Build each tank's cadence table from TDS guidance and workload, with named owners and the tightening rule
workflow.gate: every check has an interval and an owner and the tightening rule is written

workflow.action: Gate customer work on bath health
workflow.description: Release jobs only against in-window evidence, closed corrections and first-article proof where stakes demand
workflow.gate: no customer job enters a tank without dated in-window evidence and no open holds

priority_rationale: The doctrine and safety nodes come first because every later decision presumes TDS-sourced windows and an intact segregation envelope; commissioning and the log follow because control without a baseline and an evidence stream is guesswork; the parameter mechanisms precede diagnosis because signatures are mechanisms read backward; the method nodes precede arbitration and escalation because a disagreement ladder needs methods to disagree; and replenishment, cadence and the release gate come last because they compose everything upstream into the daily loop that keeps customer work plating from a demonstrably healthy bath.

dominance_rules.rule: The cyanide-acid segregation line dominates every operational convenience
dominance_rules.rationale: acid meeting cyanide makes hydrogen cyanide gas; no schedule, cost or ease argument survives contact with that fact
dominance_rules.trigger: any handling, storage, drain, trim or sampling decision that would bring cyanide-bearing and acid chemistry together
dominance_rules.action: refuse the shortcut, use the zoned equipment and TDS-named chemicals, and escalate to the supplier if the sanctioned route cannot solve the problem

dominance_rules.rule: The TDS of the product in the tank dominates memory, habit and handbook
dominance_rules.rationale: windows, dosing arithmetic and sanctioned chemicals are product-specific; borrowed numbers are how baths are quietly ruined
dominance_rules.trigger: any number about to be used that does not trace to the current product's TDS
dominance_rules.action: stop and fetch the TDS-sourced value from the control card; if the card lacks it, fix the card first

dominance_rules.rule: Measurement dominates symptom in every dosing decision
dominance_rules.rationale: signatures overlap and excursions travel in packs; dosing on looks alone stacks errors
dominance_rules.trigger: an addition is proposed on deposit appearance without a confirming measurement
dominance_rules.action: run the measurement the signature map names; the only pre-measurement act allowed is stopping work

dominance_rules.rule: The bath release gate dominates any deadline
dominance_rules.rationale: a defect shipped from an unproven bath costs the claim, the rework and the account; a delay costs an apology
dominance_rules.trigger: customer work is proposed for a tank with open corrections, live arbitration or overdue cadence
dominance_rules.action: hold the job, say so honestly, and release only on in-window evidence

dominance_rules.rule: Outside the window, the crash protocol dominates routine dosing
dominance_rules.rationale: routine little-and-often assumes an in-window bath; nursing an excursion with small doses hides it while it worsens
dominance_rules.trigger: any parameter measures outside its TDS window
dominance_rules.action: stop customer work, suspend routine dosing, and run the crash protocol to its evidence-based end

dominance_rules.rationale: correcting a healthy bath on a broken instrument's word is the classic self-inflicted bath death
dominance_rules.trigger: a correction is about to be driven by a single instrument reading
dominance_rules.action: check calibration and sampling first, re-measure, then correct if the number survives

dominance_rules.rule: The supplier lab dominates bench methods where the bench is blind
dominance_rules.rationale: proprietary additives and trace contaminants are invisible to titration, panel and coupon; only the formulator sees the whole composition
dominance_rules.trigger: persistent post-arbitration disagreement, an implicated proprietary component, or an indicated correction beyond routine dosing
dominance_rules.action: sample and ship per instruction, hold customer work on that tank, and execute the returned report per TDS

dominance_rules.rule: One-variable-per-cycle dominates the urge to fix everything at once
dominance_rules.rationale: attributability is the whole value of a correction; a shotgun dose buys speed today with next week's diagnosis
dominance_rules.trigger: multiple corrections proposed in a single cycle
dominance_rules.action: sequence them with re-measurement between, unless the supplier's own procedure explicitly couples them

dominance_rules.rule: Commercial product per TDS dominates every improvisation impulse
dominance_rules.rationale: raw-chemical additions void the TDS's meaning, the supplier's support and the shop's safety case at once
dominance_rules.trigger: any proposed addition of a chemical the TDS does not name
dominance_rules.action: refuse it; if the TDS toolbox cannot solve the problem, the supplier or the lifecycle decision inherits it

dominance_rules.rule: The minimum record set dominates bench pace
dominance_rules.rationale: an unlogged addition or measurement is evidence destroyed; every downstream discipline runs on the log
dominance_rules.trigger: schedule pressure proposes skipping or deferring log entries
dominance_rules.action: make the entry at the moment of the event; streamline the form later, never the content

anti_rework_rules.rule: Capture the commissioning baseline before the first customer job
anti_rework_rules.prevents: months of drift arguments with no healthy-day reference to compare against

anti_rework_rules.rule: Calibrate the instrument before correcting the bath on its reading
anti_rework_rules.prevents: correcting a healthy bath into a sick one on a drifted meter's word
overshoot corrections and the double-dose spiral that follows dosing on a guess

anti_rework_rules.rule: One addition, mix, re-measure, then the next
anti_rework_rules.prevents: multi-variable messes where the next drift has three suspects and the log cannot separate them

anti_rework_rules.rule: Prove a corrected bath on panel and coupon before customer work
anti_rework_rules.prevents: plating a customer order into a bath whose correction has not been verified

anti_rework_rules.rule: Log every addition with product, amount, lot and reason at the moment it is made
anti_rework_rules.prevents: unreconstructable history when a defect surfaces weeks later

anti_rework_rules.rule: Reconcile ampere-minute predictions against measured analysis on cadence
anti_rework_rules.prevents: recipe-driven starvation or flooding as the assumed efficiency drifts from the real one

anti_rework_rules.rule: Re-read the TDS on every new product, version or revision before the first dose from it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: dosing the new product on the old product's arithmetic

anti_rework_rules.rule: Derive sentinel alert bands from baseline and logged scatter, not from wishes
anti_rework_rules.prevents: alarm fatigue from arbitrary tight bands and silent drift under arbitrary loose ones

iteration_protocol.trigger: a sentinel fires (plaque shift, voltage creep, panel change, efficiency slide)
iteration_protocol.action: run the signature lookup, execute the targeted analysis it names, and dose only what the measurement confirms

iteration_protocol.trigger: any parameter measures outside its TDS window
iteration_protocol.action: stop customer work on the tank, run the crash protocol's full-set measurement and stepwise correction, and re-earn service on panel-and-coupon evidence

iteration_protocol.trigger: two measurements or a measurement and the deposit disagree
iteration_protocol.action: climb the arbitration ladder - calibration, resample, independent method, supplier lab - with no dosing until it resolves

iteration_protocol.trigger: a near-miss or excursion touches the segregation line or a pH safety floor
iteration_protocol.action: stop, treat as a safety event, review zoning, training and procedure before the tank or the practice resumes

iteration_protocol.trigger: the supplier revises the TDS, changes the product, or a new lot behaves differently
iteration_protocol.action: re-anchor the control card to the new TDS, compare windows and dosing arithmetic, and re-baseline if composition-relevant anything changed

iteration_protocol.trigger: predicted and measured gold consumption diverge beyond the stated band
iteration_protocol.action: re-measure efficiency on a coupon, audit ampere-minute capture and area assumptions, and update the ledger's figure from measurement

iteration_protocol.trigger: corrections keep failing to hold the bath in window
iteration_protocol.action: escalate to the supplier lab with sample and log excerpt, and open the lifecycle question - this is where maintenance ends and the regenerate-or-retire decision begins

iteration_protocol.trigger: sentinels false-alarm repeatedly or miss a real drift
iteration_protocol.action: retune alert bands from the log's current scatter and review the cadence table's intervals and owners
